worlds.title: 猫猫勇者与狗狗魔王
worlds.titleEn: The Cat Hero and the Dog Demon King
worlds.subtitleEn: One paw at a time, bring the sunshine home
worlds.descriptionEn: A timid orange cat sets out to reclaim the naptime sunshine hidden in the dog demon king's castle. No claws draw blood—only cushions, bells, and a wish to wake the town gently.
